plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the MeadowID identity dashboard, focusing on the primary settings/privacy flow, adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will start with the Overview page, then move to key functional pages (Connected Apps, Active Sessions, Passkeys, Data Export, Freeze Account) to validate interactions, states, and recovery paths. It will also check mobile viewport issues and ensure all known pages are covered.
assumptions: All pages load without errors (per prescan)
Interactables are functional as per their labels
Layout warnings (small tap targets) are valid and need validation on mobile

phases.title: Overview Page Exploration
phases.objective: Validate Overview page interactions, stats, and alert flows.

phases.title: Connected Apps Page
phases.objective: Validate app list, filtering, and revocation flow.

phases.title: Active Sessions (Devices) Page
phases.objective: Validate session list, session ending, and unfamiliar session handling.

phases.title: Passkeys & 2FA Page
phases.objective: Validate passkey management, backup factors, and recovery paths.

phases.title: Data Export & Freeze Account
phases.objective: Validate data export options and freeze account state.
key_checks: Verify freeze account description and toggle
exit_criteria: All Data Export and Freeze interactables exercised

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-validate critical flows on mobile viewport (small tap targets, responsive layout).
key_checks: Re-exercise critical interactables (Overview alerts, Connected Apps revoke, Passkeys add)
Verify small tap targets on mobile

coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible controls (buttons, links, inputs) per key page
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (revoke, recovery, alerts) on mobile viewport

notes: Prioritize critical paths (recovery, revocation, freeze) for deeper validation.

prescan_summary.title: Freeze account — MeadowID
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: MeadowID ◐ Overview ⇄ Connected apps ▢ Active sessions ⌘ Passkeys & 2FA ↓ Export your data ❄ Freeze account JT Jamal Tarrant jamal@thirdpond.dev Freeze account A freeze is the strongest, reversible version of "stop everything." We use it for incidents. It is not the same as deleting your account. What freezing does Every connected app is signed out and rejected until you unfreeze. New tokens cannot be issued. Sign-ins are blocked from every device. You'll need your password and a passkey or backup code to unfreeze. Subscriptions, automatic backups, and recurring data exports are paused. Your data is not deleted. Nothing is shared with apps. You stay billed only if a free trial is converting. What freezing does not do It does not remove sessions on third-party servers that don't honor token revocation (extremely rare; we report these). It does not freeze accounts you opened with email/pas
